name: Garry's Mod
description: The Garry's Mod dedicated server (srcds), installed from Steam with SteamCMD. Pick the standard 32-bit build or the 64-bit x86-64 branch, the start map and the gamemode. A Workshop collection is downloaded on every start when you give a Steam Web API key. Gamemodes and addons go in server/garrysmod (file manager or SFTP). Optionally a MariaDB database runs beside the server, with MySQLOO installed for the gamemodes that use it.

install.script:
#!/bin/sh
# Ionnet GSM install: Garry's Mod dedicated server from Steam (app 4020). Runs as the instance user
# in /data; SteamCMD keeps its own files in /data/Steam.
set -eu
cd /data
BRANCH="${GMOD_BRANCH:-public}"
case "$BRANCH" in
  "" | *[!A-Za-z0-9._-]*) echo "Invalid Steam branch: $BRANCH" >&2; exit 1 ;;
esac
set -- +force_install_dir /data/server +login anonymous +app_update 4020
[ "$BRANCH" = public ] || set -- "$@" -beta "$BRANCH"
set -- "$@" validate +quit
# A fresh SteamCMD updates itself on its first run and drops an app_update queued with it.
steamcmd +quit >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
echo "Installing Garry's Mod (branch $BRANCH) with SteamCMD. The first download is about 6 GB."
tries=1
until steamcmd "$@"; do
  [ "$tries" -lt 3 ] || { echo "SteamCMD failed $tries times; giving up." >&2; exit 1; }
  tries=$((tries + 1))
  echo "SteamCMD failed; trying again in 10 seconds ($tries/3) ..."
  sleep 10
done
[ -x server/srcds_run ] || { echo "The server is missing after the install." >&2; exit 1; }
mkdir -p server/garrysmod/cfg server/garrysmod/addons server/garrysmod/gamemodes server/garrysmod/data/gsm server/garrysmod/lua/bin
if [ "${MYSQLOO:-false}" = true ]; then
  # Pinned by version and checksum; the 64-bit branch needs the 64-bit module.
  V=9.8.0-Beta3
  if [ "$BRANCH" = x86-64 ]; then
    F=gmsv_mysqloo_linux64.dll; SUM=95e49209d260fdf851b8fac37bb23aa0b3e862d81a50c6938f07dc55359b472f
  else
    F=gmsv_mysqloo_linux.dll; SUM=c9ce96d15ab24f1015928ae812d2bef05f52be27cf94ffa69f227744942bb1f1
  fi
  echo "Installing MySQLOO $V ($F)"
  curl -fsSL --retry 3 -o "server/garrysmod/lua/bin/$F.tmp" "https://github.com/FredyH/MySQLOO/releases/download/$V/$F"
  echo "$SUM  server/garrysmod/lua/bin/$F.tmp" | sha256sum -c -
  mv "server/garrysmod/lua/bin/$F.tmp" "server/garrysmod/lua/bin/$F"
fi
echo "Install complete."

startup: cd /data/server && set -- -game garrysmod -console -norestart -port "$GSM_PORT_GAME" +ip 0.0.0.0 -tickrate "$TICKRATE" +maxplayers "$MAX_PLAYERS" +gamemode "$GAMEMODE" +map "$MAP"; [ -z "$GSLT" ] || set -- "$@" +sv_setsteamaccount "$GSLT"; if [ -n "$WORKSHOP_COLLECTION" ]; then if [ -n "$STEAM_API_KEY" ]; then set -- "$@" +host_workshop_collection "$WORKSHOP_COLLECTION" -authkey "$STEAM_API_KEY"; else echo '[GSM] The Workshop collection needs a Steam Web API key; starting without it.'; fi; fi; BIN=./srcds_run; [ "$GMOD_BRANCH" != x86-64 ] || BIN=./srcds_run_x64; exec script -qfec "$BIN $* $EXTRA_ARGS" /dev/null

console.readyPattern: ^(?:VAC secure mode (?:is activated|disabled)\.|Could not establish connection to Steam servers\.)

variables.name: GMOD_BRANCH
variables.label: Game version (Steam branch)
variables.description: public is the standard 32-bit build; x86-64 has 64-bit binaries, and binary modules must be 64-bit too. Changing it needs a reinstall.

variables.name: MAP
variables.label: Start map
variables.description: A map in garrysmod/maps or in the Workshop collection.

variables.name: GAMEMODE
variables.label: Gamemode
variables.description: The gamemode's folder in garrysmod/gamemodes: sandbox, terrortown, or one you upload.

variables.name: SERVER_PASSWORD
variables.label: Join password
variables.description: Players need it to join. Empty for an open server.

variables.name: REGION
variables.label: Region
variables.description: Where the server browser lists it.

variables.name: GSLT
variables.label: Game server login token
variables.description: Lets the server keep its place in the server browser. Make one for app 4000 at steamcommunity.com/dev/managegameservers.

variables.name: WORKSHOP_COLLECTION
variables.label: Workshop collection
variables.description: The id of a Workshop collection the server downloads and mounts on every start. Needs the Steam Web API key.

variables.name: STEAM_API_KEY
variables.label: Steam Web API key
variables.description: From steamcommunity.com/dev/apikey; only used to download the Workshop collection.

variables.name: FASTDL_URL
variables.label: FastDL address
variables.description: sv_downloadurl: a web server clients download custom content from.

variables.name: LOADING_URL
variables.label: Loading screen
variables.description: sv_loadingurl: a web page shown while players join.

variables.name: DATABASE
variables.label: MariaDB database
variables.description: Runs a MariaDB server beside the game, reachable as db:3306. The credentials are on the Database tab and in garrysmod/data/gsm/database.json.

variables.name: MYSQLOO
variables.label: Install MySQLOO
variables.description: Adds the MySQLOO module (9.8.0-Beta3) for gamemodes that talk to MySQL. Takes effect on the next install or reinstall.

variables.name: EXTRA_ARGS
variables.label: More command-line options
variables.description: Added to the srcds command line, like -disableluarefresh or +sv_lan 0.
